title: Calculation of Gut Metabolic Modules from Gene Profile
author: Qi Wang
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.be7ajhie

steps.title: Assign KOs to Gene Catalogues
steps.instruction: Translate putative amino acid sequences from gene catalogues and align them against KEGG databases (release 79.0, excluding animal and plant genes) to determine KO group assignments.

substeps.instruction: Perform alignment using BLASTP (v2.2.26) with parameters: -e 0.01, -b 100, -K 1, -F T, -m 8.
Assign each protein to the KO group based on the highest scoring annotated hit(s) with at least one HSP scoring >60 bits.
Calculate the relative abundance profile of KOs by summing the relative abundance of genes from each KO.

steps.title: Calculate Gut Metabolic Modules
steps.instruction: Run the gut metabolic module calculation using the gmms.jar tool with the specified command and reference files.

substeps.instruction: Execute the command: 'java -jar gmms.jar -a 2 -d GMMs.v1.07.txt -i input_KO_profile -s average -o index'
